tech_stack.name: SQLite
tech_stack.evidence_quote: Data Backup/Recovery: The system must implement an automated, daily backup mechanism for the entire SQLite database file, stored in a secure, separate location

requirements.text: The system must implement an automated, daily backup mechanism for the entire SQLite database file, stored in a secure, separate location.
requirements.evidence_quote: Data Backup/Recovery: The system must implement an automated, daily backup mechanism for the entire SQLite database file, stored in a secure, separate location to prevent data loss in the event of system failure.

requirements.text: All user input forms shall implement client-side and server-side validation to prevent injection attacks and ensure data integrity.
requirements.evidence_quote: All user input forms (especially grading, attendance marking, and profile updates) shall implement client-side and server-side validation to prevent injection attacks and ensure data integrity.

requirements.text: Any action that results in permanent deletion or deactivation of data must require a mandatory two-step confirmation.
requirements.evidence_quote: Any action that results in the permanent dele- tion or deactivation of data (e.g., deleting a user account or deleting an announcement) must require a mandatory two-step confirmation (e.g., a modal window) to prevent ac- cidental data loss.

requirements.text: User authentication must use session-based authentication.
requirements.evidence_quote: User authentication must use session-based authentication.

requirements.text: All passwords must be stored using a strong, one-way hashing algorithm.
requirements.evidence_quote: All passwords must be stored using a strong, one-way hashing algorithm.

requirements.text: The system shall log all sensitive administrative actions and unauthorized access attempts for audit purposes.
requirements.evidence_quote: The system shall log all sensitive administrative actions (e.g., user creation, password resets, teacher assignment) and unauthorized access attempts for audit purposes.

requirements.text: The system shall maintain an availability of 99% during core school operating hours (7:00 AM to 5:00 PM on weekdays).
requirements.evidence_quote: The system shall maintain an availability of 99% during core school operating hours (7:00 AM to 5:00 PM on weekdays).

requirements.text: The system must prevent data corruption during simultaneous write operations by utilizing database transaction locks (ACID properties).
requirements.evidence_quote: The system must prevent data corruption during simultaneous write operations (e.g., two teachers submitting attendance at the exact same moment) by utilizing database transaction locks (ACID properties).

requirements.text: The system shall log all runtime errors internally and provide user-friendly error messages that guide the user back to a valid state without losing input data.
requirements.evidence_quote: The system shall log all runtime errors internally and provide user-friendly error messages that guide the user back to a valid state without losing input data.

requirements.text: Critical issues shall raise immediate alerts for the administrator.
requirements.evidence_quote: Critical issues shall raise immediate alerts for the administrator.
